message.content: {"verdict":"HOLD","cited_clauses":[4],"reasons":[{"clause":4,"finding":"The requested wallet differs from the wallet on file, and confirmation through the contractor’s email on file is required before payment.","evidence_quote":"[WALLET_MISMATCH] Invoice asks for payment to 0x94e672298C44c94b0606740cBEfa6963fA3409C6; wallet on file is 0x4c7C5f70F851D649b353D56981F7898188dA93D4."},{"clause":4,"finding":"The invoice requests a payment-details change; that request has not been confirmed through the contractor’s email on file.","evidence_quote":"[WALLET_CHANGE_REQUEST] Invoice contains a payment-details change request: \"My old wallet was frozen by the exchange — please use my new address below.\""}],"policy_covers":true,"suspected_manipulation":true}
